description: This PHP class 'PendingAppraisalReviewSummary' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Dashboard\Dto\ActionSummary' models a summary of pending appraisal reviews associated with an employee. It provides methods to retrieve group information and count of pending reviews, utilizing trait-based service functions and related domain objects.

classes.name: PendingAppraisalReviewSummary
classes.description: Represents a summary of pending appraisal reviews for a specific employee, providing group info and pending count.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with an employee number, setting up search filter parameters for review statuses.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the ID representing the group category for this summary.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the human-readable name of the group.

methods.name: getPendingActionCount
methods.description: Fetches the count of pending appraisal reviews using the associated service and filter parameters.
